name: cairn-verify
displayName: Cairn Verify — did the AI really fix it?
description: Checks what your coding agent said it did — fixed, tested, removed, wired, no behaviour change — against the repository, and gives each claim a verdict in plain words: holds, doesn't hold, or can't tell. Unsticks an agent going in circles by finding the live and dead copies it keeps confusing. Read-only, self-testing script.
